card.name: Small words before institutional nouns
card.fires_on: Short linking words like "the", "to" or "less", and some nouns like "editorial" or "insurance", inside general-web phrases about institutions, titles or organizations. It fires just before the next noun in a phrase, such as a company, faculty or book title.

modes.label: The before names and titles
modes.description: The word "the" inside book titles, institutions or company names, just before a proper noun.
modes.example: Myths and Legends of<< the>> Ancient Near East.

modes.label: Modifier nouns before a group noun
modes.description: A modifier noun such as "editorial" or "insurance" placed before a word like offices or companies.
modes.example: A slow pulse is usually considered by the life<< insurance>> companies to be a sign of long life

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Words like "to" or "less" inside fixed phrases, partway through a clause.
modes.example: From 1897 as "one who is up<< to>> date."
